$comment: Which revision of each upstream contract owner this assembly derives from.
A pin, not a copy. nexus-vfs owns zone-id/zone-path projections; nexus
owns the product Zone/ZoneGrant/ResourceRef/ZoneOperation schemas and the
shared fixture corpus; moss owns iam/v1 but has no cross-repo consumer
yet, so its entry is recorded for provenance only — no public iam/v1
export is derived from it (an empty package for a language nobody
consumes would be worse than none).
The nexus-vfs rev must match the revision the shipped daemon builds use;
the nexus rev is the draft-frozen owner commit that carries contracts/.
Scope: this pin fixes the ZONE-V1 FAMILY derivation only. The
pinned separately by contracts/sources.lock.json — two lineages, each
locked to full immutable commits (ADR005-SOURCE-02). Aligning this pin
onto the sources.lock revision is its own work item, not a silent bump.
